title: Abashushanya amabuye bo mu kibaya cya kera
intro: Tekereza umuco wazamutse mu bibaya by'amabuye byo muri Arabiya, bafite ubuhanga mu gushushanya amazu meza cyane uhereye ku misozi. Bateye imbere cyane mu mbaraga no mu bugeni, ariko inkuru yabo irangwa no kwirengagiza umuburo w'Imana mu buryo buteye ubwoba. Uko ugenda wiga inkuru yabo, uzavumbura ubwoko bwagize ubwibone bwatumye burimbuka burundu. Bari bande?
clues: Twarazwe igihugu cy'ibibaya by'amabuye n'ibihanamanga birebire, aho twubatse amazu yacu mu buhanga budasanzwe.
Twari tuzwiho gucukura amazu atekanye mu misozi, twumva dufite umutekano ku byago byose.
Intumwa yatugezeho iturutse hagati yacu, itwibutsa ineza za Allah inatuburira ibihano.
Twasabye ikimenyetso, maze ingamiya y'ingore y'igitangaza iva mu rutare, ikizamini gisobanutse neza cyavuye kuri Allah.
Twanze umuburo maze dutema ingamiya y'ingore, duseka intumwa tunayishinja igihano.
Igisasu kimwe cyatugezeho mu ngo zacu, maze mu gitondo turaryama duhanze amaso, nk'aho tutigeze tubayo.
